target: वह परीक्षा के लिए रोज़ दो घंटे पढ़ती है।
english: She studies two hours every day for the exam.
reason: Padded — the doubled adverb 'बहुत मेहनत और ध्यान से' is textbook filler; replacement keeps के लिए + habitual present but says something concrete.

target: पहले हम शाम को पार्क में ताश खेलते थे।
english: We used to play cards in the park in the evening.
reason: Niche rural vocabulary (चौपाल) a learner will never use; same habitual-past pattern kept with everyday setting.

target: वह रसोई में चाय बना रहा है।
english: He is making tea in the kitchen.
reason: Occupational trivia (potter at the wheel) — learner will never say it; replaced with an everyday present-continuous sentence.

target: ड्राइवर ने ब्रेक लगाकर गाड़ी रोकी।
english: The driver applied the brakes and stopped the car.
reason: Niche/literary (boatman dropping anchor); replacement keeps the V-कर + ने-past structure with common vocabulary.
Unnatural/wrong — 'ठंडी जैकेट' means a cold jacket; nobody says this. Hindi uses गर्म for warm clothing.

target: राजेश ने सारा काम एक दिन में पूरा कर दिया।
english: Rajesh finished all the work in one day.
reason: Translationese — 'एक ही बैठक में' is a calque of English 'in one sitting'; replacement keeps the compound verb कर दिया.

target: पंकज ने कहा कि उसे कल जाना है।
english: Pankaj said that he has to go tomorrow.
reason: Near-duplicate filler — identical to hi-1772/hi-1774 with only the name changed; same कि-clause taught with new content.

target: अनिल ने कहा कि उसका फ़ोन खो गया है।
english: Anil said that his phone is lost.
reason: Near-duplicate filler — identical to hi-1772/hi-1773 with only the name changed; same कि-clause taught with new content.

target: यह कमरा दूसरे कमरे से ठंडा रहता है।
english: This room stays cooler than the other one.
reason: Textbook trivia about earthen vs metal pots; replacement keeps the से comparative + रहता है in a sentence people actually say.

target: छोटा बच्चा बहुत प्यारा बोलता है।
english: The little child speaks very sweetly.
reason: Unnatural and niche — 'तोतला बच्चा अलग ही प्यारा बोलता है' is odd phrasing and unkind framing; same generic present kept.

target: वह मंच पर नाच रही है।
english: She is dancing on the stage.
reason: Niche content plus formal register (कथक प्रस्तुत कर रही है); replacement keeps present continuous in ordinary speech.

target: हमारे स्कूल में एक ही टीचर सब कुछ पढ़ाते थे।
english: At our school one teacher used to teach everything.
reason: Archaic vocabulary (पाठशाला, गुरुजी) a modern learner won't use; same habitual-past structure in current words.

target: माता-पिता अपने बच्चों के लिए रोज़ टिफ़िन बनाते हैं।
english: Parents make lunch for their children every day.
reason: Preachy/moralising ('parents always sacrifice'); replacement keeps अपने + के लिए + habitual present with a concrete everyday action.

target: यहाँ सब्ज़ी बाज़ार से सस्ती मिलती है।
english: Vegetables are cheaper here than at the market.
reason: Pointless trivia (iron vs copper prices); replacement keeps the से + सस्ता comparative in a useful shopping context.

target: यह ट्रेन रोज़ सुबह छह बजे चलती है।
english: This train runs at six every morning.
reason: Vacuous — 'a train runs in the tunnel' is not something anyone says; same habitual present with a usable travel sentence.

target: टीचर ने बच्चों को कॉपियाँ बाँटीं।
english: The teacher handed out notebooks to the children.
reason: Occupational officialese (contractor distributing wages to labourers); replacement keeps ने + को + बाँटना in everyday context.
